note: Reviewed dev packages left out of dependency bundles. Security relevant: every entry is part of the dev section digest and the bundle sha256, and a human reviews this file with the bundle manifest before setting a pin. Each entry names the exact version the lockfile pins and why the test suite does not need it.

excludedDev.name: cypress
excludedDev.reason: Used only by the test:e2e, test:ci and cy:verify scripts and test/e2e; npm test runs grunt test (env:test, mochaTest:unit), which never loads it. Its install script downloads a binary, so it cannot be bundled.

excludedDev.name: nodemon
excludedDev.reason: Used only by the dev script and the Gruntfile concurrent task (run and default), not by grunt test. Its install script cannot run with lifecycle scripts disabled.

excludedDev.name: grunt-if
excludedDev.reason: Resolves to a GitHub tarball, not the npm registry. Only the testsecurity task uses it; grunt test does not. The Gruntfile loads it with loadNpmTasks, which logs a missing module and continues (the Gruntfile also sets force).
